'''Taylak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] Scout Chief who could be found in the [[Gormak Lands]] on [[Voss]]. He was eventually killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] allied individual during the [[Galactic War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Taylak appears in the mission ''Sabotage the Gormak'' in the [[2011]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for Republic players.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
